notes: Simulated at nominal values. Tolerances are not swept, so a limit that holds here holds at nominal only.

models.source: Texas Instruments, https://www.ti.com/lit/zip/SNOM488 (LM1117 3P3 Unencrypted PSpice Transient Model), Final 1.1, 17 March 2015, for datasheet SNOS412M
models.note: subcircuit LM1117_N_3P3_TRANS from LM1117_N_3P3_TRANS.LIB; the maker says it covers: a transient model; the file states no scope. Its parameters give dropout against load current, a 1.2 A current limit, a 1.5 V under-voltage lockout, a start-up time, a supply-rejection pole and zero, and 1.5 mohm of output resistance
an ideal 1e-05 F; nominal (no DC-bias data), so in use it is likely less; no ESR stated, so none is modelled
an ideal 2.2e-05 F; nominal (no DC-bias data), so in use it is likely less; no ESR stated, so none is modelled
conducts above its stated forward voltage of 2 V and drops that at any current; a real diode's drop rises with current, so currents near turn-on are not represented
a step from 0 V to 5 V in 1e-06 s behind 0.05 ohm and 1e-06 H
a 11 ohm resistor (3.3 V / 0.3 A). The design gives the load's current, not how it behaves below nominal voltage
